summary: An edge-case sweep invoked the capability with a credential the application rejects. The run did not stop at the sign-on screen: it went on looking for the Member ID textbox that a signed-on session would have shown, ran out the step timeout, and failed with target_not_found marked escalatable — which pages an operator over a wrong password, something no operator can fix. A rejected credential is a legitimate answer the caller needs back. This is the application's own vocabulary rather than anything specific to this flow, so SIGN_ON_FAILED has been added to the meridian_core profile and every capability compiled from now on carries it; this review back-fills it into an artifact that was compiled before it existed, because versions are immutable.

addOutcomes.description: The application rejected the supplied operator credentials. Retrying cannot help, and neither can a person taking over the session, because the credential the caller holds is the one that is wrong.
